name: INCLINE BENCH PRESS
description: Athlete lies back and presses the dumbbells into lockout position on the incline bench

name: CHEST-SUPPORTED T-BAR ROW
description: Athlete finishes gripping and begins pulling under heavy load on the chest-supported row

name: MACHINE CHEST FLY
description: Athlete finishes bringing handles together into starting position and begins the eccentric fly motion of rep 1.

name: WIDE-GRIP LAT PULLDOWN
description: Athlete finishes seating into position and initiates the first downward pull on the lat pulldown bar.
